entities.name: Félicien Kabuga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félicien Kabuga is a Rwandan businessman and génocidaire who played a major role in the run-up to the Rwandan genocide. A multimillionaire, he was closely connected to President Juvénal Habyarimana's Hutu Power MRND party and the Akazu, an informal group of Hutu extremists who helped lead the Rwandan genocide.
